text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like I started working with<n>Mejiro Dober
just the other day, but<n>three years is swiftly coming
to a<n>close.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's left quite the indelible mark on<n>the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But this is far from the end of her<n>journey, and in
order to shine even<n>brighter, she'll be pushing
herself<n>just as hard today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew. That should be good enough<n>for a warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: You're so cool, Dober! You're the<n>best racer ever!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
The levels of preciousness she and<n>Bright share
when they run together...<n>I've been blessed this
morning...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list:
You don't get nervous anymore, even when you're
being watched.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I guess you're right. I couldn't<n>stand having
any eyes on me when<n>we first met.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It feels like so long ago...

Hmm. I must say, I don't think that's<n>the biggest
change in you, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, compared to three years ago...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You're far, far, faaar more honest<n>with your trainer!
♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? No, I'm not! What are you<n>even talking
about?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: B-Bright! Don't say it like that! It's<n>embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Never mind! I've never thought<n>anything about him,
got it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goodness, how terrifying! ♪ I'd best<n>run for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can never get in a wordagainst her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Why I'm so different than I was three<n>years ago.
